source_text: In 2012, the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) updated its policy, concluding that these preventive benefits—encompassing HIV, other STIs, and UTIs—outweigh procedural risks (complication rate ~0.2-0.6% in neonatal settings), justifying access for parents though not routine universal recommendation. [94]
